findings.description: Path.Combine(_rootDir, filePath, fileName) is unsafe if filePath is attacker-controlled.
Path.Combine(_rootDir, filePath, fileName) is unsafe if filePath is attacker-controlled.
The caller controls where files are created, and File.WriteAllText will overwrite existing files.
If any directory in filePath is a symlink/reparse point, the final path may resolve outside _rootDir.
Even if you validate a path first, a time-of-check/time-of-use race exists if an attacker can swap a directory or symlink between validation and write.
Using a shared Random (Rnd) is not cryptographically secure and is not thread-safe.
